phase: Phase 11: Ablations, robustness, and evidence assessment

protocol.clustering: frozen KMeans(n_clusters=5, n_init=10), fit on train and predict on test

retention_protocol.inference: Wilson 95% intervals, Pearson chi-square omnibus, Fisher exact pairwise tests with Holm correction

robustness.missing_text_policy: explicit availability masks; no rows dropped

prior_test_exploration: Phase 6 through Phase 10 used the blind test for exploratory reporting. Phase 11 applies the frozen protocol and does not retune or select configurations from new test outcomes.

interpretation.claim: Do not claim H-MoE superiority without a positive, stable comparison against the strongest fair static baseline.
